items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for fleet-wide go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases; ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: the read-only security baseline covers 61 managed sites, but fleet-doctor is not OK and has no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results; and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are not evidenced. TLS certificate expiry is not flagged within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS security. Compliance reports 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown and is technical baseline evidence only, not certification. Exact decision: preserve private-launch and security-sensitive release gates; do not claim clearance or certification; continue only authorized read-only evidence capture.

No new security proposal, deployment, credential/configuration change, dependency addition, telemetry request, exploit activity, or external disclosure outreach is approved. Reassess only when dated retained artifacts or authorized metadata evidence authentication and access boundaries, secret handling, runtime isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring and incident response, and security.txt/disclosure readiness.
